title: automate-kms-tls-rotation-private-installer-helm-terraform-vault-sealed-secrets
author: Samir Rao
description: Motivation: automate periodic TLS certificate and KMS/HSM key rotation for Private deployments (VPC/on-prem) and reduce operator toil. This PR adds an opinionated rotation controller, Helm chart flags, Terraform module wiring for KMS keys, integration with Vault and sealed-secrets, and upgrade/rollback hooks to ensure safe migrations. Key goals: 1) support automated, auditable rotations using customer-managed KMS/HSM or Vault as the root of trust; 2) minimize disruption during rotation with staged replace-and-validate flows and canary rollout knobs; 3) provide Terraform and Helm primitives so operators can enable rotations consistently across environments. Changes include: operator: new rotation controller and CronJob runner that requests new keys/certs and performs atomic swaps via sealed-secrets; vault: secret engine integration + helper for pkcs12 export; helm: values flags for rotationPolicy, canaryPercent, vault/kms backend config, hooks for pre-upgrade backup and post-upgrade validate; terraform: module updates to create/attach KMS keys (AWS/Azure/GCP HSM placeholders) and IAM roles for operator; docs: upgrade notes and runbook for incident recovery; tests: e2e integration tests in test harness using a local Vault dev server and sealed-secrets. Checklist: - [x] rotation controller implementation and unit tests - [x] Helm chart templates + values schema - [x] Terraform module changes + examples - [x] sealed-secrets integration + pre-apply migration script - [x] integration tests and CI pipeline steps - [x] docs and runbook links | Related: ENG-4972 (rotation design), SEC-121 (KMS policy review). This description contains implementation notes and commands: - To enable automated rotation set values.rotation.enabled=true and configure values.rotation.backend=(vault|aws_kms|hsm). - For Vault: configure values.vault.addr and values.vault.auth.path; operator will create a periodic lease and request cert generation. - For sealed-secrets: operator will decrypt and re-encrypt secrets during the swap and annotate resources with redwood.inference/rotation-id. Rollback: Helm hook pre-upgrade backs up current sealed secrets to S3/GCS (configurable) and operator supports revert by applying backup tarball. Security: All KMS interactions require dedicated service principal/role; Terraform adds policy docs and an example for HSM customers to bring-your-own-HSM. Notes on safety: rotations are staggered (control plane -> serving nodes) to ensure KV cache compatibility and graceful connection draining. See release_notes for high-level summary.
